name: DominoPilot – AI Live Chat Assistant
author: Dominopress

sections.description:
If you are looking for a live chat WordPress plugin free to set up, DominoPilot is the ultimate solution. This WordPress live chat plugin transforms how you interact with visitors by using advanced AI. Whether you are wondering how to add live chat to a wordpress website or need reliable wp live chat support, our assistant scans your content on-the-fly.

Easily add live chat to your website and benefit from a live chat WordPress experience that understands your store. It is the perfect way to add live chat to WordPress sites running WooCommerce, ensuring your customers get instant help with a live chat WordPress plugin that actually knows your products.

Key Features:

  • Smart Store Integration: A live chat WordPress free feature that scans products to answer prices and availability queries.
  • Site-Aware Responses: High-quality wp live chat support based on your specific posts and pages.
  • Customizable UI: Edit titles and welcome messages to fit your brand.
  • Zero Configuration Needed: Starts working immediately upon activation.

Service Disclosure:

This plugin relies on third-party AI services to generate responses. By default, it is configured to work with the LongCat AI API endpoint.
* Service Used: The plugin securely sends visitor chat messages (along with relevant site context) to the LongCat AI API.
* Data Sharing: Visitor chat prompts and limited website context (such as matched product descriptions) are sent to the external API provider for processing.
* Privacy Policy: Please refer to the LongCat AI Privacy Policy for details.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the dominopilot-ai folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the “Domino Pilot” menu to configure your Chat Settings.
  4. Check the “Enable Live Chat” box to display the widget on your site front-end!
sections.faq:
Do I need to provide my own API key?

No! The plugin comes pre-configured with a default LongCat API key and model so you can start using it immediately without any advanced setup.

Does this work with WooCommerce?

Yes. The AI automatically scans your WooCommerce product database when a user asks a question, providing details such as price, availability, and a direct link to the product.

Can I customize the chat widget?

Absolutely. You can customize the chat window title, the initial welcome message, and the loading indicator text from the Domino Pilot settings page.

  • Transformed plugin into an AI Live Chat Assistant.
  • Added dynamic WooCommerce product and post scanning context.
  • Added customizable chat UI text settings.
  • Hidden advanced API configurations by default to improve ease of use.

  • Initial release.
